name: civic-skills-search-the-exchange
description: Searches the published civic-skill-exchange index for installable skills by category, jurisdiction, or a free-text description of the need, and reports each result's tier, scan status, and disclaimer alongside it. Reads the live index and category vocabulary rather than a bundled copy, so results and categories stay current as the registry changes. Never presents a Community listing as reviewed.
